evidence_status: Extracted source account with separately retained local validation receipts; no proof execution was performed for this publication copy.
reported_checked_statements:
1. any access authorised through a capability by the abstract CHERI memory
   automaton lies within that capability's memory region;
2. a tagged capability derived monotonically from an exact object root cannot
   gain memory authority outside the root;
3. an access authorised through that derived capability therefore remains in
   the exact root object's spatial region;
4. the abstract bounded memory-template predicate requires matching access
   direction, authority class, architectural root register, offset, width,
   data register, capability-memory encoding, and exactly one final memory
   operation;
5. the abstract authority-transition predicate requires supported capability
   copies, immediate/register pointer derivations, and fixed helper operations
   without hidden memory or authority-sensitive effects;
6. an abstract accepted source/emission trace has equal length and every
   indexed pair satisfies the corresponding memory or authority predicate;
   every memory or authority step also owns a nonempty native interval, while
   ordinary steps may legitimately own an empty interval;
7. a complete emitted-instruction-envelope certificate requires five adjacent
   regions: nonempty rebuilt prologue, contiguous BPF body, absent-or-two-word
   software failure stub, rebuilt epilogue, and a two-or-three-word exact PLT;
   PLT exclusion from generated-code executable authority is an explicit
   composition premise;
8. for any indexed direct access in a complete certificate, an explicit event
   match binds the certified kind, width, total offset, data register, source
   range, final native index, selected root, dereference register, and effective
   address to the architectural access, while equating the architectural word
   with the word retained at that index in the accepted complete native image;
9. when the selected live register is the exact object root and the actual
   dereference register is the end of a monotonic derivation path from it,
   Morello authorization confines the access to that object's spatial region;
10. given an exact `0x1337`-byte array-map root, the historical reduced
   eight-byte pre-base read, a one-byte upper-bound write, and the current
   CVE-2021-3490 eight-byte adjacent-value store at stride `0x1338` are not
   authorised;
11. the composed containment result is available in the upstream
   `Morello_Mem_Axiom_Automaton` locale, checking the concrete Morello
   instantiation rather than leaving that connection only in prose; and
12. broad authority, a wrong root, a wrong emitted capability, helper-mediated
   effects, temporal misuse, and non-spatial effects do not satisfy the full
   direct-spatial claim;
13. the normalized ABI-v3 abstract checker-policy target consumes one raw word
   image and source-only steps (no expected-word or emitted-field assertions)
   and implies the existing full-envelope predicate, without claiming that the
   translated C return value establishes that target; and
14. a finite direct-memory trace satisfies containment and fault-before-effect
   when each event has an explicit discharge of the existing conditional
   Morello theorem and the four environment assumptions hold; and
15. the minimized root constructor's fact set contains no direct verifier-
   analysis fact, while the deployed stack profile's construction set has
   exactly one such fact: the verifier-derived stack extent. For the modeled
   array-map pipeline, the complete direct-verifier footprint is exactly object
   provenance, verifier root summary, and offload eligibility. Range lower and
   upper bounds, offset validity, and final admission are disjoint from that
   footprint; changing all four while holding retained facts fixed leaves the
   admitted exact-root request unchanged;
16. the abstract verifier-fact gate copies every accepted authority field from
   independently supplied facts. For fixed independent facts, verifier reports
   can change acceptance but two accepted reports cannot select different
   outputs. Explicit counterexamples retain wrong independent provider identity
   and kernel extent as common-mode failures;
17. the accepted abstract gate refines a representability-checked 128-byte wire
   model. A conditional gate-composed finite-trace theorem fixes assigned event
   intervals to the independent map root and carries an abstract source,
   emitted-image, and site-set binding; and
18. CParser and AutoCorres translate the exact production fact-gate entry point
   and all four helpers. A partial Hoare theorem covers every accepted scalar
   and all four output-digest words. For valid disjoint records and typed/raw
   digest-storage coherence, the wire bridge derives every pure acceptance
   guard, exact independent output, and typed-input preservation from C
   acceptance; no semantic acceptance guard is a precondition. Total
   non-failure, concrete-heap discharge of the storage-coherence premise, exact
   rejection codes 3--16, the deployed digest realization, and Linux/runtime
   composition remain explicitly pending.

accepted_c_fact_gate_result.source_report: The production fact-gate accepted direction derives every pure acceptance guard, independent scalar output and all four digest words while preserving typed inputs.
accepted_c_fact_gate_result.receipt_limit: These later timings and successes are reported in the formal README and later audit; a separate raw build transcript is not included in this public subset.

explicit_limits: Containment is conditional on exact assigned roots, tags, authorization, monotonic derivation, live register paths, word/event semantics and native correspondence.
The complete envelope is five regions; the normalized ABI-v3 checker requires its software-stub interval to be empty. The earlier abstract envelope can represent an absent or two-word stub.
The two August-30 receipts apply to their original source snapshots. The three-helper bridge includes an emitted-field helper from that earlier version; it does not establish the later ABI-v3 core.

The August-30 helper receipt records the older circularity limitation; the later README reports a non-circular per-event discharge while still requiring its soundness and universal runtime correspondence.

Full C acceptance-to-envelope refinement, array loops and raw decoder correctness, universal trace correspondence, concrete heap storage coherence, totality, rejection codes 3–16, deployed digest realization and Linux adapter refinement remain open.

The fixed-512-byte-stack candidate is not the deployed stack profile. Its backing/layout premise is not supplied by the abstract constructor theorem; the deployed constructor still consumes verifier stack extent.
Source and validation accounts do not establish a verified JIT, arbitrary BPF safety, general helper semantics, temporal safety or whole-system isolation.
Proof sources, proof toolchains and raw build logs are retained in the original research archive, not restored as an implementation or reproducible proof build in this subset.
